findings.title: Claim form amount claimed differs from the sum of hospital bill and pharmacy bills
findings.detail: The claim form states an amount claimed of 76939.83, while the hospital bill total payable (75659.83) plus the pharmacy bill total (1280.00) equals 76939.83, but there is a discrepancy with the hospital bill subtotal and calculations.

findings.title: ICU stay duration in hospital bill differs from clinical record description
findings.detail: The hospital bill charges for 2 days of ICU, whereas the discharge summary states the patient was managed in the ICU and shifted to the ward on day 3 of admission.

quotes.quote: Managed in the ICU with dual antiplatelet therapy, anticoagulation and cardiac monitoring. Shifted to the ward on day 3 of admission

findings.title: Pharmacy bill purchased outside hospital lacks matching prescription reference
findings.detail: Pharmacy bill from CarePlus Chemists is dated 11 Dec 2024 with reference RX5723, but no corresponding external prescription document with reference RX5723 is found in the file.

findings.title: Pharmacy bill date falls during admission but purchased at an external location
findings.detail: Pharmacy bill is dated 11 Dec 2024 from Noida during an admission at a hospital in Pune.

quotes.quote: Admission Date 10 Dec 2024 Discharge Date 14 Dec 2024

findings.title: Patient identity is consistent across all documents
findings.detail: No discrepancies found in patient identity.
